jobs.description:
Job Posting:

Since 1953, Ferguson has been a source of quality supplies for a variety of industries. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes and better businesses. We exist to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. We proactively solve problems, adapt and grow to continuously serve our customers, communities and each other. Ferguson, a Fortune 500 company, is proud to provide best-in-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in.

Role Overview

The Credit Services Specialist serves as a primary point of contact for a nationwide customer base, providing timely, accurate, and professional support across a range of credit-related tasks. This role focuses on delivering a positive customer experience by addressing questions, resolving problems, and ensuring satisfaction through every interaction. This role is approved to be fully remote and can be based anywhere in the United States.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Review incoming lien waiver requests and sworn statements for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with internal guidelines.
  • Validate supporting documentation (proof of payment, invoices, job information).
  • Ensure compliance with state-specific lien waiver laws and internal risk policies.
  • Use Billtrust to confirm customer payments, remittance details, and cash posting status.
  • Navigate Trilogy to access customer job information, invoice data, order history, and account notes to ensure waiver accuracy.
  • Use a Notary platform to electronically process notarized lien waivers when required by state regulations or customer contracts.
  • Use the Handle Platform to execute waivers.
  • Communicate with customers, sales teams, field credit regarding waiver requests
  • Responsible for managing a high volume of emails daily and take inbound calls
  • Serve as primary point of contact for nationwide customer base ensuring consistency of service.
  • Act as a liaison between customers and customer-facing associates/departments.
  • Ensure timely and accurate resolution of account‑related issues while maintaining best-in-class customer service.
  • Resolve customer issues by investigating and troubleshooting problems and providing appropriate solutions.

Qualifications

  • Credit experience of 1 - 3 years
  • Effectively communicate verbally and in writing
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office software (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, etc.)
  • Must have strong and accurate data entry skills
  • Perform basic math functions
  • Proven track record of responding quickly to customer needs and ability to make decisions in a timely manner.
  • Ability to react well in a fast-paced environment and adapt to change
  • Ability to prioritize workload appropriately in order to balance multiple demands and meet timelines as required
  • Eagerness to learn and strong critical thinking skills required
  • All applicants must be highly detail oriented and have outstanding interpersonal skills
  • Understanding of constructions lien waivers would be a plus

At Ferguson, we care for each other. We value our well-being just as much as our hard work. We are committed to a holistic approach towards benefits plans and programs that support the mental, physical and financial well-being of our associates. Our competitive offering not only includes benefits like health, dental, vision, paid time off, life insurance and a 401(k) with a company match, but our associates also enjoy additional meaningful and inclusive enhancements that are adaptable to their diverse situations and needs, including mental health coverage, gender affirming and family building benefits, paid parental leave, associate discounts, community involvement opportunities and more!

jobs.excerpt: Engineering is being transformed by Agentic AI - and you get to decide whether you watch it happen from the sidelines, or help shape it from the front row.
jobs.description:
Engineering is being transformed by Agentic AI - and you get to decide whether you watch it happen from the sidelines, or help shape it from the front row. 🌟

At Synera - the AI Agent Platform for Engineering - we're redefining how the world's most complex industries develop products. Backed by a world-class partner ecosystem including AWS, Autodesk, UiPath, Capgemini, McKinsey, and Accenture, and trusted by teams at Hyundai, ArianeSpace, and NASA, we're looking for a driven, entrepreneurial German-speaking sales professional to continue growing our presence in the German market.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

Join our distributed sales team across Germany and the United States, united by a passion for innovative technology and a shared mission to help our customers become industry leaders. You will be at the forefront of one of the most significant shifts in engineering history - selling Synera's AI Agent Platform to the companies that build our physical world. This role is ideal for a proactive and results-oriented sales professional who excel at expanding existing opportunities, strengthening customer relationships, and increasing market penetration to deliver sustained impact.

  • Monday: You start the week with a Team Kick-Off to review goals and align on priorities, while engaging in outbound activities and reaching out to potential leads.

  • Tuesday: You focus on qualifying the leads by pitching Synera and conducting demos to showcase its value.

  • Wednesday: you conduct thorough use case screenings and deep dives with potential customers to qualify opportunities, and sync with your team lead, Markus.

  • Thursday: You drive the closing process, aiming to finalize deals and secure new business partnerships.

  • Friday: You use this time to refine strategies, seek feedback, and plan for continuous improvement in your role.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • You achieve your first win(s) by successfully closing an opportunity!

⚡ In 12 months:

  • You continue growing our customer base.

Here is our team at last year’s summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • You're in the front row of an AI transformation - selling a product that is actively changing how the world's top engineering teams work, not a commodity.

  • You collaborate with innovative customers and top companies like Hyundai, ArianeSpace and NASA.

  • You take on responsibility from day one, empowering you to make impactful decisions and drive real success.

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Requirements

🌱 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • Proven B2B SaaS Sales Expertise: You bring a strong track record of success in selling technically complex software solutions within a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Established Industry Network: You possess an active and well-developed network of relevant contacts within our target market, enabling you to generate and accelerate business opportunities.

  • Engineering Domain Expertise: You have an engineering background or hands-on experience working with or selling engineering software (e.g., CAD, CAE, PLM, or similar solutions), enabling you to effectively engage with technical stakeholders and understand customer challenges.

  • Executive-Level Engagement: You are skilled at building relationships with C-level and senior stakeholders and bring an existing portfolio of relevant accounts within our industry.

  • You confidently represent the company at conferences and industry events, delivering compelling presentations with professionalism and charisma.

  • You're genuinely excited about where AI is taking the engineering world - you don't need to be a technical expert, but you're curious, informed, and eager to have that conversation with customers.

  • You are nativeGerman and fluent in English, allowing you to communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders in an international environment.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our Sales team.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About ApprovalMax ApprovalMax is a fast-growing B2B SaaS company that helps businesses automate their approval workflows and financial controls.
jobs.description:
About ApprovalMax
ApprovalMax is a fast-growing B2B SaaS company that helps businesses automate their approval workflows and financial controls. With a global team of over 100 people spanning the UK, Europe, North America, Australia, and South Africa, we build software that matters and we're scaling quickly.

The Role
Reporting to the Data Platform Lead, you will be a hands-on senior engineer responsible for building and maintaining ApprovalMax's enterprise data platform. You will own the design and delivery of production-grade data pipelines, drive engineering quality across the data stack, and act as a technical mentor for the broader analytics team. As we mature our hub-and-spoke model, you will be a key partner to embedded analysts and a core contributor to making the platform agentic-ready and self-service by default. This is a senior individual contributor role: deep technical work, broad influence, no direct reports.

Remote —applicants must be based in the UK, Serbia or Moldova.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Development & Platform Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines, ingestion processes, and transformation layers on Azure Data Lake Gen2 + Databricks.

  • Own the implementation of core data models in dbt: from source-aligned staging through to marts and semantic layers consumed by Power BI, Amplitude, and downstream tools.

  • Write production-grade Python for orchestration, custom ingestion, and data transformation logic; treat pipeline code with the same rigour as application code.

  • Investigate and resolve pipeline failures within agreed SLAs; lead root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes rather than one-off patches.

  • Optimise pipeline performance and Databricks compute usage; surface cost and performance opportunities to the Data Platform Lead.

Data Quality, Testing & Observability

  • Implement and maintain data quality frameworks (dbt tests, Great Expectations, or equivalent) across the platform; ensure critical data assets have explicit quality contracts.

  • Instrument pipelines with monitoring, alerting, and lineage so issues are detected before they reach consumers.

  • Define and enforce testing standards for ingestion jobs and dbt models: unit tests, integration tests, and freshness/volume/schema checks.

  • Contribute to incident response: take on-call shifts as part of the rotation, lead post-mortems for incidents you own, and drive action items to closure.

Data Contracts & Source-of-Truth Stewardship

  • Partner with Product Engineering, RevOps, and Finance to define and maintain data contracts; ensure upstream changes are reflected before downstream impact.

  • Contribute to the Central KPI & Metrics Glossary from a data lineage perspective: make it unambiguous which systems feed which metrics and how each is computed.

  • Be the technical owner of critical data domains (e.g. subscriptions, billing, product usage); know them deeply enough to defend the numbers in front of SLT.

Analytics Enablement & Hub-and-Spoke Support

  • Provide robust, well-documented data models and tooling that allow embedded (spoke) analysts to work independently without re-deriving core logic.

  • Pair with analysts on complex modelling problems; help them level up on dbt, SQL performance, and semantic layer design.

  • Champion LLM-assisted development across the analytics team: model how to use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or equivalent) as a default workflow for pipeline and model development.

AI/ML & Agentic Readiness

  • Build data assets to be agentic-ready by default: clean semantic layers, consistent metadata, documented contracts that AI agents and LLM tools can reliably consume.

  • Contribute to the technical foundations for AI/ML initiatives: ingestion of training data, feature pipelines, evaluation datasets, and inference logging.

  • Support delivery of natural-language interfaces to ApprovalMax's data (e.g. text-to-SQL, LLM-powered analytics chatbot) by ensuring the underlying data models are query-friendly and well-described.

    Engineering Standards & Technical Leadership

  • Act as a technical authority on the data team: lead design reviews, review pull requests with substance, and be the person analysts and engineers bring hard problems to.

  • Contribute to Architecture Decision Records (ADRs); ensure significant technical choices are documented, justified, and revisable.

  • Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines for dbt models and ingestion jobs; enforce environment promotion discipline (dev -> staging -> prod).

  • Mentor more junior engineers and analysts informally: code review, pairing, and lifting the technical bar across the team.

  • Contribute to the visible technical debt backlog; advocate clearly for capacity to address debt alongside feature delivery.

Essential Key Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience building and operating production data platforms in a SaaS or B2B product environment.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI coding agents as a core part of your development workflow, not as a novelty but as a default. You should be able to show how agent-assisted development (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent) has materially changed how fast you ship and how you approach technical problems. We are building an agentic-ready data platform, and we need senior engineers who already work this way.

  • Strong hands-on expertise with cloud-native data platforms, ideally Azure (Data Lake Gen2, Databricks). Equivalent depth on AWS or GCP stacks will be considered.

  • Expert-level command of the modern data stack: dbt, SQL, dimensional and source-aligned data modelling, semantic layers, and data quality frameworks (Great Expectations, Monte Carlo, or equivalent).

  • Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, Databricks Workflows, or similar); comfortable writing and maintaining production pipeline code.

  • Experience defining and consuming data contracts in collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.

  • Track record of raising engineering maturity in data functions: CI/CD for data pipelines, testing standards, environment promotion, observability, and incident response.

  • Comfortable being on-call for the data platform and owning incidents end-to-end.

  • Strong written communication: able to document architecture, write ADRs, and explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience contributing to AI/ML infrastructure: feature stores, vector stores, model-serving layers, or evaluation pipelines.

  • Familiarity with LLM application patterns: RAG, text-to-SQL, prompt and response logging, agent orchestration frameworks.

  • Experience working within a hub-and-spoke or embedded analytics operating model.

  • Prior experience as a lead engineer or tech lead on a small data team, even without direct reports.

  • SaaS or B2B product company background with exposure to product analytics and GTM data.

What We Offer

  • Salary of €85,000 - €95,000, dependent on experience/location

  • Health & Wellbeing Benefit Stipend

  • Home Office Setup - one off £500 reimbursement, post probation

  • 26 days of paid time off

  • 1 additional day off for your birthday

  • Service-years recognition financial reward

  • Regular performance-based compensation reviews

  • Growing international business with 10,000+ subscribers

jobs.excerpt: We're transforming the grocery industryAt Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together.
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart Ads powers one of the industry's leading retail media networks, enabling Instacart and its retailer partners to deliver highly relevant, effective advertising experiences at scale. As part of the Ad Product team, you'll sit at the intersection of machine learning, marketplace dynamics, and measurable business impact — helping shape the future of how brands connect with shoppers across the Instacart platform.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the systems that drive core auction understanding and marketplace balance within our Ads Quality domain. This is a high-impact, technically complex space where your work will directly influence the health of the ads ecosystem — from how auctions are structured and optimized to how quality signals inform ranking and relevance. You'll partner closely with a team of talented machine learning engineers and ads engineers who are building at the frontier of what's possible in retail media.

If you're energized by ambiguous, high-stakes problems, fluent in the language of ML and online advertising, and eager to accelerate experimentation in a fast-moving environment — this is the role for you.

About the Job

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for ads quality systems, including auction mechanics, marketplace balance, and the signals that govern ad ranking and relevance across Instacart's retail media network.
  • Drive the strategy and execution for increasing the velocity of experimentation across the ads quality team — designing frameworks that allow the team to test, learn, and iterate faster without sacrificing rigor or integrity.
  • Work hands-on with machine learning engineers and ads engineers to translate complex ML model outputs and auction dynamics into clear product requirements, hypotheses, and measurable outcomes.
  • Define and track the right success metrics for ads quality, navigating tradeoffs between advertiser performance, shopper experience, and marketplace health — and communicating those tradeoffs clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Operate in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment where priorities shift, new data surfaces frequently, and the ability to make good decisions under uncertainty is essential to moving the business forward.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of product management experience in online advertising, ad tech, or a closely related domain — with a demonstrated understanding of auction mechanics, bidding systems, or ad quality signals.
  • 2+ years of experience working directly with machine learning teams or ML-driven products, with the ability to engage substantively in technical conversations about model design, evaluation, and tradeoffs.
  • Proven track record of defining and executing on product roadmaps in complex, data-rich environments with multiple cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform product decisions, measure impact, and design experiments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and how they can be applied within ads or ranking systems.
  • Experience working with ads machine learning models in a production environment, including relevance scoring, auction optimization, or quality filtering.
  • Prior experience at a retail media network, demand-side platform, or supply-side platform, with exposure to the full advertising stack.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, high-growth environments where structure and process are still being built — and an eagerness to help build them.

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.

Job Details

The Community Pharmacy Team Lead supports the Community Pharmacy Team Manager by supervising a team of pharmacists and technicians responsible for patient care, medication dispensing support, pharmacy operations, clinical documentation, quality assurance, and client service activities.

This role serves as a first-line resource for staff, helping coordinate daily workflow, resolve operational and clinical escalations, support adherence to standard operating procedures, and ensure timely, accurate, and compliant pharmacy services. The Team Lead uses clinical judgment, operational knowledge, and strong communication skills to help the team deliver safe, efficient, patient-centered medication management services.

The Team Lead is expected to model professionalism, accountability, sound decision-making, and collaboration across pharmacists, technicians, managers, clients, prescribers, community pharmacies, and other healthcare partners.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Daily Workflow Oversight

  • Provides day-to-day guidance, support, and directions to assigned pharmacists and technicians.

  • Assists the Community Pharmacy Team Manager with monitoring daily workflow, staffing alignment, work queues, service levels, and completion of assigned tasks.

  • Serves as a first point of escalation for staff questions related to workflow, patient care processes, documentation, dispensing support, and client-specific procedures.

  • Help prioritize urgent, same-day, next-business-day, cycle-fill, and other operational requests based on patient needs, regulatory requirements, and company procedures.

  • Supports staff in resolving barriers that may delay medication access, documentation completion, prescription processing, or patient care follow-up.

  • Monitors team productivity, quality, and timeliness and communicates concerns, trends, or improvement opportunities to the Community Pharmacy Team Manager.

  • Assists with onboarding, training, coaching, and ongoing development of pharmacists and technicians.

  • Reinforces standard operating procedures, client-specific workflows, documentation standards, quality expectations, and compliance requirements.

  • Helps maintain a positive, accountable, and collaborative team culture.

  • Escalates performance, attendance, conduct, quality, or compliance concerns to the Community Pharmacy Team Manager in a timely and objective manner.

  • Ensures clinical recommendation standards and documentation quality; leads calibration and coaching.

ATM/CPN/Same-Day Medication Support

  • Monitors Same Day Technician Pre-Check & Pharmacist Verification queues to ensure compliance with client SLAs.

  • Supports oversight of ATM dispensing and related operational activities.

  • Assists with Community Pharmacy Network transfers and ensures appropriate internal documentation of completed work.

  • Help coordinate medication procurement through local pharmacies for same-day or urgent medication needs.

  • Provides or verifies necessary prescription documentation to support safe and accurate dispensing by local pharmacies.

  • Supports staff in providing appropriate billing, insurance, and processing information to community pharmacy partners when needed.

  • Helps identify and resolve CPN-related issues, including technology, logistics, documentation, workflow, billing, and communication concerns.

  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with community pharmacy partners.

  • Assists with training staff and clients on proper CPN and same-day medication procedures.

Patient Pharmacotherapy and Clinical Support

  • Supports the team in maintaining accurate patient-specific medication profiles and care documentation within company systems.

  • Reviews medication-related questions and escalations from pharmacists, technicians, clients, prescribers, patients, caregivers, and other healthcare professionals.

  • Uses professional judgment to help ensure timely, accurate, and appropriate pharmaceutical care.

  • Reviews new medication requests, medication changes, and patient-specific clinical information when needed to support safety, appropriateness, and continuity of care.

  • Assists pharmacists with identifying medication-related problems and developing appropriate recommendations to improve patient outcomes and reduce medication-related risk.

  • Supports monthly medication profile review, cycle-fill review, medication review preparation, and other patient care activities as assigned.

  • Helps ensure that patient care decisions, interventions, communications, and follow-up actions are documented accurately and consistently.

  • Provides medication counseling, education, and clinical clarification when appropriate and within scope of practice.

  • Supports prospective drug utilization review and other pharmacist responsibilities as required by applicable laws, regulations, and company policy.

  • Participates in on-call, emergency call retrieval, or after-hours support when assigned.

Quality Assurance, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement

  • Assists the Community Pharmacy Team Manager with monitoring team compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, quality standards, and pharmacy practice expectations.

  • Reviews workflow trends, documentation quality, dispensing support issues, client concerns, and operational barriers to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Supports investigation, documentation, and resolution of quality assurance events, HIPAA concerns, fraud, waste, and abuse concerns, medication access issues, or other compliance matters.

  • Helps ensure that patient care activities, coding, billing, dispensing support, and operational actions are properly documented in company systems.

  • Provides reports, feedback, and analysis to the Community Pharmacy Team Manager as requested.

  • Collaborates with operations, clinical leadership, account management, IT, software development, fulfillment, and other internal partners to improve workflow, automation, quality, and efficiency.

  • Participates in process improvement initiatives, staff education, workflow redesign, and implementation of new procedures or technology.

  • Supports a culture of continuous audit readiness and proactive issue resolution.

Communication and Cross-Functional Communication

  • Serves as a professional and responsive resource for pharmacists, technicians, clients, prescribers, patients, caregivers, community pharmacies, and internal departments.

  • Communicates clearly and respectfully through written, verbal, and interpersonal interactions.

  • Help ensure that staff communications are accurate, timely, complete, and aligned with company expectations.

  • Partners with the Community Pharmacy Team Manager to identify recurring client concerns, service gaps, workflow breakdowns, and staff training needs.

  • Escalates urgent or high-risk matters promptly and appropriately.

  • Promote collaboration between pharmacists and technicians to support safe, efficient, and patient-centered pharmacy care.

  • Embody AnewHealth’s Core Values in all communications and interactions.

  • Other duties as assigned.

The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position.

Qualifications: These represent the desired qualifications of the ideal candidate. They are not meant to limit consideration for candidates who do not meet all of the standards listed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education

  • PharmD, required

  • BCGP, required

  • A current, active license in the state of NJ, required.

  • Must be registered or eligible to become registered with the appropriate State Board of Pharmacy within 90 days of hire.

Experience

  • Required: 1+ years of pharmacy operations, clinical pharmacy, geriatric pharmacy, PACE, long-term care, community pharmacy, or related healthcare experience.

  • Prior experience providing day-to-day team guidance, workflow coordination, training, mentoring, or informal leadership.

  • Experience working in a call center, centralized pharmacy, clinical operations, medication management, or high-volume pharmacy environment.

  • Experience with quality assurance, documentation review, performance improvement, and staff coaching.

  • Experience supporting geriatric patients, medically complex populations, or interdisciplinary care teams.

  • Experience with internal pharmacy systems, EHR platforms, pharmacy dispensing systems, clinical decision support tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.

Skills & Abilities

  • Proficient with MS Office Suite.

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

  • Ability to communicate effectively and professionally through written, verbal (e.g., face-to-face, telephonically and/or virtual communication platforms), and interpersonal skills as applied when interacting with employees, patients, healthcare professionals, clients, or agency representatives; successfully conveying and exchanging information at an appropriate level and in a positive and timely manner.

  • Strong technical and computer skills to navigate proprietary and other pharmacy software and the initiative to propose suggestions to improve operations and proprietary system development and enhancements.

  • Demonstrated experience with problem-solving, conflict resolution, and project management skills.

  • Detail oriented and organized with the ability to work with a sense of urgency, work under pressure, multi-task, and achieve deadlines without sacrificing quality.

  • Strong data entry capability.

  • Strong analytical skills with good clinical judgement and decision-making including (1) the ability to effectively and efficiently identify and rectify medication-related problems, and (2) assess patients using verbal and/or visual cues, when appropriate.

  • Knowledge of state and federal laws and regulations, including HIPAA and Fraud, Waste, and Abuse.

  • Possesses high level of integrity

  • Quality-oriented

  • Innovative

  • Steadfast

Schedule: 10AM-6:30PM ET Thursday-Monday

This is a full-time position with an expectation to work an average of 40 hours per week and be available outside of normal business hours to meet customer expectations on an ad-hoc basis. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed. Rotating weekly On-Call oversight schedule required.

jobs.description:
Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators.

Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world.

The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit

Role Overview:

As a member of the Global Customer Solutions (GCS) Group, you will provide technical support for the pre- and post-sales activities of Telesat’s product lines and technical consultation to the Global Sales groups. As a champion of new technology, you will develop effective solutions to meet customer communication needs leveraging Telesat’s Lightspeed constellation. The position’s primary role is to support the Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region teams, but will also assist across Telesat’s global presence.

The GCS team is responsible for the gathering of requirements from customers, design of cost-effective Lightspeed satellite and terrestrial communication link solutions, specifying both the space and ground segment components, and presenting solutions to customers. Additionally, you will be offering technology recommendations and advice, performing modeling and simulations, and conducting test and evaluation demonstrations aiming to secure sales and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, estimate cost, and propose Lightspeed communications solutions based on customer requirements
  • Work directly with the Global Sales Team and prospective customers’ Engineering contacts to validate requirements and technical details
  • Prepare, present proposals to, and review requirements directly with customers
  • Lead, attend, and actively participate in customer meetings
  • Identify new solutions within Telesat’s Lightspeed product portfolio which could lead to new revenue opportunities with customers
  • Work directly with customers to plan upgrades, review performance of networks, and to resolve service issues
  • Collaborate with Telesat’s Marketing and Product teams to identify available network capacity
  • Support projects from design to implementation
  • Update and maintain multiple databases as well as other Engineering information management systems
  • Actively participate in trade shows, customer events, and technical demonstrations in presentation roles

Education & Experience Required:

  • Bachelor degree or comparable experience in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Technology, Telecommunications, or Electrical Engineering required
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in systems engineering or connectivity solutions
  • Experience with satellite communications, RF link analysis, and RF hardware preferred

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Inquisitive nature and eagerness to learn and explore new concepts
  • Positive outlook in meeting challenges and working to a high level
  • Confident when presenting to peers and management within the organization
  • Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously
  • Analytical skills with the ability to solve technical and business issues
  • Ability to foster and maintain good working relationships with peers, partners, and customers
  • Previous experience supporting Carrier, Mobile Network Operator (MNO), and Wholesale accounts. Working for a Carrier or an MNO would be desired
  • A professional demeanor and appearance with strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to multi-task and work in a team environment.
  • Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA, CCNP, Juniper JNCIA/ENT preferable
  • Experience and understanding of computer hardware, software, and operating systems
  • Working knowledge of MEF 3.0 standards and implementations
  • Working knowledge of:
  • OSI Layer 1 (Optical, HFC, WDM)
  • OSI Layer 2 & 3 (Switching, STP, VLAN, MPLS, Carrier Ethernet, IP, etc.)
  • Protocol acceleration, web caching, traffic management, firewalls, VPN, and security related hardware and software
  • 3G/4G/5G cellular networking technologies
  • Network management platforms (SolarWinds, WhatsUp Gold, etc.)

Other Requirements:

  • Ability and willingness to travel to attend customer meetings and events across the region
  • Fluent English is required and French is highly desirable (written and spoken)

jobs.description:
CTS delivers comprehensive IT solutions to meet the unique demands of mission-driven organizations. We have deep expertise in supporting nonprofits and educational institutions, however our team is equipped to handle the complexities of IT across a variety of sectors. We’re committed to making technology work seamlessly, so our clients can focus on making a difference, regardless of their industry.

At CTS, we believe in building a company culture that fosters growth, collaboration, and innovation. By joining our team, you will not only help empower businesses with cutting-edge IT solutions but also build a rewarding career in a dynamic and supportive environment. Discover the many reasons why CTS is a great place to advance your career. We are headquartered in Brooklyn, NY with 90+ employees across the US and several other countries. Learn more about us at

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking an experienced SOC Supervisor to lead the day-to-day operations of our Security Operations Center. This role is responsible for managing SOC personnel, overseeing alert and incident response workflows, ensuring service levels and quality standards are met, and driving continuous operational improvement.

The SOC Supervisor serves as both a tactical leader and a strategic manager. On the tactical side, this person oversees queue health, coordinates major incident response, removes blockers for engineers, and acts as the highest point of operational escalation. On the strategic side, the role focuses on people leadership, process governance, KPI reporting, quality assurance, and SOC maturity initiatives.

This is a leadership role for someone who can balance operational oversight, incident command, coaching and development, and continuous process improvement in a fast-paced managed services environment.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Oversight & Incident Handling

  • Oversee daily SOC operations and monitor the health of the alert and ticket queue
  • Balance workloads across SOC team members to ensure efficient operations
  • Act as Incident Commander during critical or high-impact security incidents
  • Lead communications with customers, internal IT teams, and executive stakeholders during major incidents
  • Ensure the team consistently meets SLAs for triage, response, escalation, and resolution
  • Remove technical, operational, or cross-functional blockers impacting investigations
  • Serve as the highest point of operational escalation for the team or shift
  • Review handoff logs and ensure continuity across shifts

Team Leadership & People Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop SOC staff across multiple experience levels
  • Conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings focused on performance, growth, and career development
  • Manage shift schedules, coverage plans, on-call rotations, and time-off requests
  • Build training plans and support skill development for junior and mid-level analysts
  • Address performance, behavioral, and engagement issues promptly and professionally
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and blameless team culture
  • Support internal talent progression and promotion readiness

Quality Assurance

  • Conduct regular QA reviews of closed, escalated, and high-impact tickets
  • Ensure SOC documentation is accurate, complete, professional, and audit-ready
  • Identify recurring quality issues or knowledge gaps across the team
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve analysis quality and communication
  • Address stakeholder feedback related to investigation quality or customer communication

Process Governance & Playbooks

  • Enforce the use of approved playbooks, SOPs, and standardized workflows
  • Ensure team members contribute to the creation and maintenance of playbooks
  • Review and approve updates to core SOC processes and response procedures
  • Maintain operational compliance with internal standards and relevant regulatory requirements
  • Drive consistency in incident handling and reduce reliance on tribal knowledge

Operational Improvement

  • Analyze SOC metrics such as time to triage, time to contain, response efficiency, and queue aging
  • Identify process bottlenecks and implement workflow improvements
  • Advocate for tooling enhancements, automation opportunities, and detection tuning
  • Partner with Detection Engineering, Threat Intelligence, IT, and other teams to close operational gaps
  • Reduce analyst fatigue and false positives through process and technology improvements
  • Help mature the SOC from a reactive function into a proactive security operation

Reporting, Communication & Ownership

  • Generate and present KPI and performance reporting to leadership on a regular basis
  • Provide accurate, transparent updates on SOC operations, risks, and team performance
  • Represent the SOC in cross-functional meetings and stakeholder discussions
  • Proactively identify risks to service delivery, including staffing shortages, tooling issues, and process gaps
  • Take accountability for team outcomes and lead root cause analysis and corrective actions when issues arise

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Strong leadership and people management skills in a SOC, NOC, or security operations environment
  • Experience leading major incident response and serving in an incident command role
  • Deep understanding of SOC workflows, escalation paths, case management, and alert triage operations
  • Ability to manage queue health, prioritize competing operational demands, and maintain SLA performance
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical teams, customers, and executive stakeholders
  • Experience with QA reviews, documentation standards, and audit-ready case handling
  • Ability to use metrics and reporting to drive operational decisions and continuous improvement
  • Knowledge of playbook development, SOP governance, and process standardization
  • Familiarity with detection tuning, SOAR/automation opportunities, and operational tooling improvements
  • Strong coaching, mentoring, and performance management capabilities
  • Ability to stay calm and decisive in high-pressure situations
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to balance tactical response with strategic initiatives

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Operations, Incident Response, or Cybersecurity Operations
  • 2+ years of experience in a leadership, supervisory, or team lead role within a SOC or similar environment
  • Experience managing analysts or engineers across multiple levels of seniority
  • Proven experience overseeing security incidents, escalations, and operational workflows in a 24x7 or shift-based environment
  • Experience working with SOC tooling such as SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, ticketing systems, and case management platforms
  • Strong understanding of incident response processes, threat detection, escalation management, and security operations best practices
  • Experience with KPI development, SLA tracking, and operational performance reporting
  • Familiarity with audit, compliance, and documentation requirements relevant to security operations
  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred
  • Industry certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIH, GCIA, CISSP, or equivalent are preferred

WORK SCHEDULE & LOCATION

  • This is a full-time remote role, 8am – 5pm EST, Monday – Friday. Occasional travel for CTS Cybersecurity and team building events is expected (3-4 times a year).

COMPENSATION

The salary range for this role is $110,000 - $115,000.

BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation
  • Health Insurance (medical, vision, dental), 80% covered for employee-only plans and 75% covered for employee-spouse, employee-kids, and employee-family plans
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Retirement Plan (401(k)) with company match
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Short-Term Disability Insurance fully paid by the company
  • Long-Term Disability Insurance fully paid by the company
  • Life and AD&D Insurance, with optional Supplemental Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off, including Paid Parental Leave
  • 10 Holidays
  • 2 Floating Holidays

Learn more at (information available in English and Spanish).

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We aim to move fast. You’ll receive scheduling emails from through Greenhouse.

Depending on the role, some steps may be adjusted or added - we’ll let you know upfront!

1. Screening call with a member of our HR team (30 minutes)
2. Technical interview with the Hiring Manager (45 minutes)

4. (If applicable) Executive interview

Social Media Manager – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Social Media Manager to own and grow the company’s presence across multiple social media platforms.

This is not a scheduling-only role. We’re looking for someone who genuinely lives and breathes social media—someone who understands platform culture, creates content that feels native to each channel, and knows how to build engaged online communities.

From day one, you’ll take ownership of 10 social media accounts, beginning with a comprehensive account audit and strategic improvement plan. You’ll then execute platform-specific content strategies, create engaging short-form content, manage community engagement, and optimize performance across LinkedIn, X (Twitter), StockTwits, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, Bluesky, and Pinterest.

If you understand that what performs on LinkedIn is very different from what succeeds on TikTok, Reddit, or StockTwits—and can adapt accordingly—this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Social Media Strategy & Account Audits

  • Conduct comprehensive audits of existing social media accounts and identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop platform-specific content strategies aligned with audience behavior and business objectives.
  • Create and maintain structured content calendars across all active platforms.
  • Identify content gaps, engagement opportunities, and audience growth strategies.
  • Continuously refine social strategies based on platform trends and performance data.

Social Media Management

  • Manage and publish content across:
    • LinkedIn
    • X (Twitter)
    • StockTwits
    • YouTube
    • TikTok
    • Facebook
    • Instagram
    • Reddit
    • Bluesky
    • Pinterest
  • Monitor comments, direct messages, mentions, and community engagement daily.
  • Adapt messaging, tone, and content style for each platform’s audience.
  • Maintain a consistent publishing schedule and brand voice across all channels.

Content Creation & Video Production

  • Create and edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
  • Design graphics and visual assets using Canva or similar design tools.
  • Produce engaging, platform-native content optimized for reach and engagement.
  • Repurpose content effectively across channels without making it feel repetitive.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop compelling marketing content.

Community Growth & Engagement

  • Grow social media accounts through authentic community engagement.
  • Participate in conversations across Reddit, StockTwits, and other relevant communities.
  • Monitor trends, industry conversations, and emerging content formats.
  • Build audience trust through meaningful interactions and timely responses.
  • Strengthen brand awareness and online community engagement.

Performance Optimization & Reporting

  • Boost high-performing content using native promotion tools across Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other platforms.
  • Manage small paid budgets to amplify top-performing posts.
  • Analyze engagement, reach, audience growth, and conversion metrics.
  • Prepare regular performance reports with actionable recommendations.
  • Continuously optimize content strategy using platform analytics and campaign insights.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You genuinely enjoy social media outside of work.
  • You understand how platform culture differs across channels.
  • You combine creativity with data-driven decision-making.
  • You can manage multiple accounts while maintaining quality and consistency.
  • You adapt quickly to trends, platform updates, and audience behavior.
  • You understand B2B, SaaS, finance, or investor-focused communication.

Required Experience & Skills

About the Role

The Product Manager (Payments) is a core execution role within WEX's Health & Benefits digital organization. This role is responsible for driving the delivery and continuous improvement of WEX's payment products — including HSA debit card rails, claims reimbursement flows, ACH/RTP money movement, real-time payment notifications, and spend authorization logic — that sit at the intersection of member experience and financial operations.

This PM operates with a strong bias for outcomes over output: they connect every feature decision to adoption, retention, cost-to-serve, or revenue impact. They bring domain fluency in healthcare payments and fintech, use AI-enabled workflows as a default starting point for synthesis and analysis, and are trusted partners across engineering, compliance, operations, and external payment vendors.

This role is the payments execution engine for H&B's product organization. The right candidate is someone who is equally comfortable reviewing ACH return codes and presenting trade-off recommendations to senior stakeholders — and who makes disciplined prioritization decisions with incomplete information.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

As a Product Manager for Payments you will:

  • Execution & Outcomes-Oriented Delivery (60%): Own end-to-end execution for payment product features including HSA debit card rails, claims auto-adjudication, ACH/RTP money movement, and real-time payment notifications. Actively participate in and facilitate core Scrum ceremonies (e.g., Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Refinement, Demos, Retrospectives), stepping up to lead ceremonies as needed. Drive short-term delivery with a bias for speed, iterating quickly based on stakeholder feedback and outcome data. Ensure delivery choices connect directly to adoption, revenue, and operational efficiency targets.

  • Discovery & Strategy Support (15%): Lead discovery for payments-specific product problems — including spend authorization flows, payment partner integrations, and compliance-adjacent money movement constraints. Synthesize customer insight, payment industry signals, and competitive intelligence into testable hypotheses. Use AI-enabled research tools to accelerate synthesis while maintaining rigorous human judgment on conclusions.

  • Insights-Driven Decision Making (10%):Navigate payment-specific metrics including authorization rates, decline rates, transaction error rates, auto-adjudication throughput, and cost-per-transaction. Use both qualitative and quantitative inputs to drive prioritization decisions. Cross-check AI-generated analysis against source data and apply appropriate rigor based on decision reversibility and risk.

  • Collaboration & Trusted Partnership (10%):Drive effective communication with engineering, compliance, finance, operations, and external payment partners (card networks, ACH processors, custodians). Clarify decision ownership, proactively resolve impediments, and ensure no ambiguity turns into delivery drift. Understand the H&B payment strategy and contribute grounded ideas on sequencing and trade-offs.

  • Customer Obsession & Learning (5%): Identify friction in the member payment experience — from card declines and reimbursement delays to claims submission errors — and translate trends into actionable product improvements. Participate in customer empathy sessions with employers, members, and brokers. Apply a test-and-learn approach to validate payment UX hypotheses before full build.

Your Skillset:

  • Payments Domain Expertise: Working knowledge of healthcare payment ecosystems: HSA/FSA/HRA debit card rails (Visa/Mastercard), ACH, RTP/FedNow, and claims reimbursement workflows. Familiarity with payment compliance constraints: IRS 213(d) substantiation rules, IIAS, Reg E, and AML/KYC implications for benefits accounts. Understanding of payment partner ecosystem: card processors, custodial bank partners, clearinghouses, and third-party payment APIs.

  • Product Execution: Ability to own end-to-end delivery for complex, dependency-heavy payment features across experience, technology, compliance, and operations.Strong prioritization discipline — can distinguish important from urgent, articulate feature trade-offs in business terms, and make bounded calls without full consensus.Comfortable operating with incomplete data; explicit about confidence levels, risk, and what still needs validation. Demonstrated track record in Agile product delivery, with hands-on experience participating in and leading team Scrum ceremonies.

  • Discovery & Customer Empathy:Experience leading discovery for payment-adjacent product problems, translating member and employer pain points into testable hypotheses. About you:

You are an experienced enablement leader who uses customer and CSM feedback to identify the highest‑leverage priorities and adjust them as business needs evolve. You have a strong track record of applying AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve scale, and free up time for more strategic enablement. You thrive in highly collaborative, cross‑functional environments and are effective at influencing stakeholders across teams. You have successfully enabled customer‑facing teams that support multiple complex products, navigate varied rules of engagement, and serve diverse buyer types across the customer lifecycle.

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Network Engineer to design, maintain, secure, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure across client environments.

This is not a helpdesk or support-only role. You’ll take ownership of network reliability, performance, and security across enterprise environments while supporting both day-to-day operations and long-term infrastructure initiatives.

Working across routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, monitoring systems, and hybrid cloud environments, you’ll ensure network infrastructure remains stable, secure, scalable, and highly available.

If you enjoy solving complex networking challenges, improving infrastructure, and maintaining mission-critical systems, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Network Infrastructure & Configuration

  • Configure, maintain, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs.
  • Implement and manage:
    • VLANs
    • QoS
    • VPN tunnels
    • Access Control Lists (ACLs)
    • Routing protocols including OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP
  • Perform firmware upgrades, patching, and infrastructure maintenance.
  • Support network expansion projects, migrations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Maintain reliable connectivity across multi-site and hybrid environments.

Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor network health using tools such as:
    • SolarWinds
    • PRTG
    • Nagios
    • Zabbix
  • Diagnose and resolve latency, packet loss, DNS, routing, and connectivity issues.
  • Troubleshoot escalated incidents using tools such as Wireshark and TCPdump.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and implement long-term preventive solutions.
  • Participate in on-call support and respond to critical network incidents when required.

Network Security & Compliance

  • Configure and maintain firewall environments including:
    • Cisco
    • Palo Alto
    • Fortinet
    • Juniper
  • Implement network segmentation, ACLs, and security policies.
  • Support compliance initiatives related to:
    • PCI-DSS
    • HIPAA
    • SOX
    • GDPR
  • Assist with Zero Trust networking and secure remote access implementations.
  • Maintain a secure, resilient, and well-governed network infrastructure.

Performance Optimization & Reliability

  • Perform bandwidth utilization analysis and capacity planning.
  • Optimize network performance through redundancy, failover, and load balancing.
  • Maintain high-availability infrastructure across enterprise environments.
  • Identify bottlenecks and recommend scalable infrastructure improvements.
  • Support cloud networking integrations across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.

Documentation & Operational Governance

  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, topology maps, SOPs, and technical documentation.
  • Document infrastructure changes following structured change management processes.
  • Keep configurations, procedures, and documentation organized and audit-ready.
  • Collaborate closely with infrastructure, cloud, security, and DevOps teams on network initiatives.

About Capitex

Capitex is a specialist contract and interim staffing firm focused exclusively on financial crime compliance. We place experienced KYC, AML, sanctions, fraud and transaction monitoring professionals with banks, financial institutions and regulated firms across the United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates and the United States.

Our clients come to us when they are under regulatory pressure and need vetted, capable people quickly — often within 24 to 48 hours. That speed only works because the administration behind it is precise. Since we were founded in 2021 we have built our reputation on exactly that combination.

We are a small, senior team. There are no layers to go through, decisions get made the same day, and the person doing a job is the person who owns it. It also means we hire carefully, because every person makes a visible difference.

The role

This role exists to take the operational running of our contractor and client administration off the desk of our CEO, so the business can grow without the back office becoming a bottleneck.

In practice, you are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. Contractors submit their timesheets because you chased them. Compliance files are complete because you collected the documents and followed up on what was missing. Our records are accurate because you keep them that way.

It is detailed, repetitive, deadline-driven work, and in our sector it genuinely matters. Our contractors work inside regulated financial institutions, which means their vetting and documentation have to be right — not roughly right. Getting that consistently correct is the core of this job.

You will report directly to our CEO and work alongside our two client-facing consultants.

What you will be doing

Timesheets and contractor administration

  • Chasing contractors and client managers for weekly and monthly timesheets across three regions
  • Collating approved timesheets and checking them against contract terms
  • Flagging discrepancies, missing approvals and anything that looks wrong
  • Preparing summary schedules for review and sign-off

Vetting, onboarding and documentation

  • Collecting onboarding documents from new contractors and following up on anything outstanding
  • Carrying out identity and right-to-work checks against a defined checklist
  • Requesting and chasing references, and recording the responses accurately
  • Maintaining complete, audit-ready compliance files for every contractor we place

Records, systems and coordination

  • Keeping contractor, client and placement records accurate and up to date
  • Maintaining our SharePoint and Teams file structure
  • Preparing invoice data for review, and issuing approved invoices
  • Liaising with Employer of Record providers on routine onboarding and document requests
  • Tracking key dates: contract end dates, document expiries, payment deadlines
  • Raising problems early rather than waiting to be asked

What this role is not

We think it is only fair to be clear about the boundaries, so you know exactly what you are taking on:

  • You will not authorise or release payments — that sits with our CEO
  • You will not set rates, margins or commercial terms
  • You will not handle escalated debt or difficult client conversations
  • You will not be doing business development or candidate sourcing

Hours and contract

Full time, approximately 10:00 to 18:30 SAST, aligned to UK business hours. Fully remote, based in South Africa. This role is offered on an initial six-month fixed-term contract through Capitex's UAE entity, with a formal review at the end of the term.

Where this can go

We are a growing business and this is our first operations hire. The role has been scoped so that someone who proves reliable on the fundamentals can take on more over time: ownership of invoicing, oversight of compliance, and eventually the wider operational running of the business as we expand across our three markets.

We would rather be honest than oversell. That progression depends on the business continuing to grow and on you demonstrating the accuracy the work demands. But the room is real, and there is no queue of people ahead of you.

How we hire

We keep it short and we give feedback at every stage.

  • Application review
  • A 30-minute introductory call
  • A short practical exercise using anonymised data: reconciling a batch of timesheets, spotting the errors, and drafting the follow-up emails. It takes around an hour.
  • A final interview with our CEO
  • References and offer

Requirements

This role is open to people early in their career. We care more about how you work than about how long you have been working.

Essential

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Founding Engineer - MemoraWe're hiring a Founding Engineer to step into one of the broadest roles on the team: A hands-on IC role with real product and cultural ownership.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Founding Engineer - Memora

We're hiring a Founding Engineer to step into one of the broadest roles on the team: A hands-on IC role with real product and cultural ownership.

The Why

Memora is growing rapidly. We need an awesome engineer in the team who can lead from all angles of the technical stack:

  • IaC end-to-end (Terraform, AWS, deploys, observability)

  • Data ingestion pipelines (large exports, QGIS, PostGIS, multi tenant setups)

  • Shipping core product features across NestJS, React, and React Native (Expo) mobile apps

  • Being a thoughtful, methodical technical voice in a small team where every engineer has outsized influence

The What (real examples from what we shipped in the last 30 days)

  • Attribute-based filter systems across PostGIS, NestJS APIs, the React, and PMTiles-backed map tiles, so our clients can visualize by contracts, preservation status to even the flower season.

  • Data import pipelines that convert raw PDF cemetery maps into geo-referenced GeoPackages in QGIS, then ingesting into PostGIS. Owning the end-to-end onboarding for new clientele.

  • Terraform: multi-AZ RDS, ECS Fargate autoscaling, CI workflows, AI guardrails, WAF, SNS, and much more.

  • AI: Designing, evaluating and building harnesses where prompts for summaries and activity can be elegantly delivered to communities, tuning guardrails.

  • Production foundations such as RLS (multi-tenancy), idempotency keys + optimistic locking… so on

The Stack

  • Backend: NestJS, TypeScript, MikroORM, PostgreSQL + PostGIS, Inngest for durable workflows

  • Web: React, TanStack Query, MapLibre + PMTiles

  • Mobile: React Native + Expo, Expo Router, native iOS/Android push

  • Infra: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS, S3, CloudFront, SNS, Bedrock, WAF), Terraform, GH actions (OIDC), Logto

  • Observability: Grafana Cloud, Sentry, CloudWatch

  • Geospatial tooling: QGIS, GeoPackage, PMTiles

  • AI: AWS Bedrock + guardrails, Promptfoo for evals

Who you are

Must have:

  • Typically 8+ years building production software, including at least one role at a growth startup or as a founding/early engineer with sizeable revenue

  • Full-stack: comfortable shipping in TypeScript across backend (Node/NestJS or similar) and React-based frontends

  • Hands-on cloud infrastructure experience: you've owned a Terraform stack on AWS, not just consumed one

  • Strong relational database fundamentals: you've designed schemas, optimized queries, run migrations against large live datasets

  • Comfortable operating in a small team without a clear playbook: you can scope your own work, write your own docs, and triage your own bugs

Strongly preferred:

  • React Native / Expo experience shipping to App Store + Play Store

  • PostGIS or any production geospatial work

  • Experience with row-level security, multi-tenancy patterns, or compliance-sensitive data (we're GDPR + public-sector)

  • Production AI/LLM work prompt design, evals, guardrails

  • B2B/B2G SaaS experience: sales cycles, real customer relationships, public-sector quirks

Bonus:

  • Experience with cemetery, GIS, or public records systems

A Note on AI
Yes, we lean hard on AI coding tools: Claude, Perplexity, Cursor, etc. and we expect you to as well. Engineers who refuse them aren't a fit, but neither are vibe coders. We ship to municipalities managing data for real families, so the bar is robust, well-tested, human-reviewed code, not "the model said it worked."
We treat these tools like a sharp junior pair-programmer: fast, occasionally brilliant, frequently wrong, and never the final authority. That means reading every diff, spotting when its tests are theatre, pushing back on its first "all-inclusive plan" building workflows with planning and review gates baked in, and being able to ship the same feature with the tools turned off. "AI wrote it" is never a defence in a postmortem.
If that distinction is obvious to you, we should talk. If your instinct is to paste this post into Claude and ask for "the final application, make no mistakes", wrong place. We're hiring humans, not the sub-agents we already work with and know well.

How we work

We’re building Memora to be the kind of company we’d want to work for ourselves: high trust, low bureaucracy, and full of people who care deeply about doing great work.

  • We’re remote by design. No, we don’t track hours or expect people to be online all day, but we do expect ownership, communication, and roughly 4 hours of overlap with Copenhagen (CET).

  • We believe great work and great lives aren’t in competition with each other. Remote work means your whole life doesn’t stop when work starts and that’s a good thing by us. Families, school pickups, deep-focus afternoons: we welcome the whole human. We optimize for people doing the best work of their careers while still having a life they’re excited to live.

  • We’re a small team. Currently 5 people, which means you’ll have real autonomy and real influence. Engineers talk to customers, help onboard them, visit cemeteries, and see first-hand how their work impacts real people. There are no layers of management and no “that’s someone else’s problem” mentality.

  • We’re low ego and high standards. We challenge ideas, admit mistakes, ask questions, and care more about getting to the right answer than being right. Psychological safety matters here, and so does excellence.

  • We’re async-first and intentionally lightweight. We write things down, keep meetings purposeful, and avoid process for process’ sake. Our default approach is simple: communicate clearly, make good decisions, and ship.

  • And because we’re building a real team, not just a collection of Slack profiles, we get together for an offsite every quarter somewhere in the world. Last time, we spent the week skiing and working together, because the best ideas don’t always happen in a meeting room.

Compensation & equity

  • Senior IC salary (currency calibrated to location)

  • Meaningful founding-engineer equity grant: we're early enough that this matters and we want you for the full journey

  • Annual leave + Danish-equivalent benefits

  • Quarterly offsites around the world

How to apply

Please send us:

1. A relevant CV

2. A short introduction

3. Pick 2 questions in the questionnaire

We’d rather hear your thoughts than read a polished cover letter. We move fast.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Backend Engineer on GitLab's Nonlinear Productivity team, you'll find and remove friction across the software development lifecycle using reliable AI-powered automation — diagnosing problems like long review cycles, manual release steps, and brittle automation, then building the automation and process changes that resolve them for good.

Some examples of the problems this team takes on:

  • Cutting the time it takes to complete a good code review — one that still keeps a human in the loop — by half, using agentic solutions.
  • Turning a manual, error-prone release step into an agentic workflow that catches its own mistakes before a human ever has to.

What you'll do

  • Identify sources of friction across GitLab's software development lifecycle and scope agentic solutions to address them, turning vague pain points into concrete, buildable proposals.
  • Design and build reliable AI-powered systems that follow step-by-step workflows, use tools and safety checks, and correct errors before taking engineering action — the kind of output you can actually trust with real engineering decisions.
  • Build and maintain evaluation tools that judge agent output on correctness, constraint compliance, and cost, not on whether it merely "seems to work."
  • Work across GitLab's codebase as each problem requires, going wherever the friction actually is rather than staying inside one service or product area.
  • Apply distributed systems judgment to identify generated code that may fail under concurrency, at scale, or across self-managed, dedicated, and multi-tenant deployments, catching failures before they reach customers.
  • Collaborate with the India-based group, sharing roadmaps, findings, and reusable agent tooling
  • Take ownership of a greenfield problem space from day one, helping shape a proven internal fix into a capability GitLab could offer customers externally, with your scope and impact free to grow as the team scales.

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on experience building agentic or large language model-based systems — multi-step orchestration, tool use, guardrails, and recovery patterns — and making them reliable in production, not treated as one-off prompts or demonstrations.
  • A track record of working autonomously in unfamiliar codebases, getting oriented quickly, and driving solutions through completion.
  • Strong distributed systems knowledge, including coordination, consistency, idempotency, rate limiting, failure modes, and degradation under load.
  • Proficiency in Go, Rust, or Python, in that order of team priority, and the ability to read and modify code in the other languages.
  • Helpful experience includes shipping autonomous agents that complete real tasks from start to finish; improving build systems, release processes, review workflows, or other parts of the software development lifecycle; and working with globally distributed teams, large language model workload costs, or production constraints across on-premises, air-gapped, single-tenant, and software-as-a-service deployments.

About the team

Nonlinear Productivity — shortened internally to "NLP," with no relation to natural language processing — is one of GitLab's newest teams: a strategic incubation group that reports into AI Platform leadership under the direct sponsorship of the CTO. It's split into a US group (this role) and an India-based group working the same charter; the two sync on roadmap and tooling a few times a week but otherwise run day to day on their own. It operates like a startup — no dedicated product manager, no pre-set backlog — and solutions that prove out internally are the team's path to a monetized, customer-facing GitLab offering.

It's a good fit for engineers who'd rather go find the next problem than be handed one, and who want a hand in defining a brand-new part of GitLab from its first commit.
